item.title: Celebration of Life for Mayor Randy Tyree
item.description: Visit Knoxville and the City of Knoxville announce a Celebration of Life for Mayor Randy Tyree on January 17, 2026, to be held on the 6th Floor of the Sunsphere. This event is open to the public, and overflow will be made available as needed. This event will also be livestreamed via the Sunsphere’s Facebook page.

item.title: VISIT KNOXVILLE INVESTS IN IMPROVED CROSS-COUNTRY TRAILS AT VICTOR ASHE PARK
item.description: Visit Knoxville announces today that the organization has invested in over one mile of improved trails to the current Cross Country Course at Victor Ashe Park. This is an 8–10’ wide course with gravel about 3–4 inches deep.

item.title: CRAFTING STORIES THROUGH SONGS: SIGNUPS OPEN TODAY FOR TENNESSEE SONGWRITERS WEEK 2026
item.description: Songwriters in all genres of music are encouraged to share their original music, as signups officially open today for the eighth annual statewide Tennessee Songwriters Week.

item.title: Visit Knoxville Announces Visitors Center Closure for Remodel
item.description: Visit Knoxville announces today that the Visitors Center at 301 S. Gay Street will be closed for a first-floor remodel to enhance the visitor experience. Construction will begin this week and is projected to last through May.

item.title: FARRAGUT MUSEUM OPENS EXHIBIT ON FARRAGUT ARTISTS

item.title: TN Songwriters Week 2026: Qualifiers Open Jan 25
item.description: Aspiring songwriters and musicians will share their original songs on stage as Tennessee Songwriters Week qualifying rounds kick off Jan. 25-Feb. 7.

item.title: Tennessee Tourism Pairs Music and Food Through New “Sound Bites” Campaign
item.description: Tennessee invites visitors to savor food in an entirely new way through Sound Bites, a new campaign launched today by the Tennessee Department of Tourist Development (TDTD). The campaign pairs two of the state’s most cherished traditions—music and food—and treats music as an intentional part of the dining experience rather than background noise. Sound Bites features Tennessee chefs and artists collaborating to create new dishes and original songs that are designed to be experienced together.

item.title: COLLEEN D’ALELIO NAMED TENNESSEE SONGWRITERS WEEK FINALIST
item.description: Tennessee Songwriters Week Knoxville finalist Colleen d'Alelio wowed judges, the audience and impressed his/her/their fellow songwriters on stage at The Bijou Theatre over the weekend, competing against 13 other songwriters to win the showcase.

item.title: Knoxville Knox County Sports Authority Announces Opening of Covenant Health Park Concourse Access
item.description: The Knoxville Knox County Sports Authority announces opening of Covenant Health Park Concourse access beginning March 23, 2026, as part of the continued activation of the multi-purpose stadium and surrounding district.

item.title: A Decade of Impact: Visit Knoxville Sports Commission Marks 10-Year Milestone
item.description: Visit Knoxville Sports Commission (VKSC) officially celebrates ten years of bringing sporting events to Knoxville and Knox County.
